adjudication.depicted_input: Panel C shows the route-defining input mechanism: a gene expression matrix serialized into single-cell "cell sentences," i.e. the text-native carrier supplied to C2S-Scale for single-cell sentence routes.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is valid under atlas rules because it clearly depicts the model-visible representation itself, not merely an unrelated upstream object. A model box is not required when the figure visibly shows the serialized input form that the paper states is given to the model. This crop therefore supports routes that consume a single cell sentence or prompt built around a single cell sentence. It does not defensibly cover multi-cell context routes or prompt-only routes whose non-cell-sentence input objects are different.
